North Delta condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings, from the MLS®. Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
North Delta market context, June to September 2026

North Delta had 209 houses and 71 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 24 and 8 sold in the month. Condos are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

items.t: North Delta real estate market stats

faq.q: Is North Delta a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in North Delta had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in North Delta?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in North Delta that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when condos come up in North Delta?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all North Delta homes?
faq.a: The North Delta homes for sale page covers every home type, and the North Delta market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
